senses.gloss: m. (טסס, sec. r. of טוּס) [glittering, flying] foil, plate.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 20b:2">Gitt. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>כתב … על טס וכ׳</he> if he wrote to her a letter of divorce on gold foil; Y. ib. II, 44ᵇ.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:6">Kel. XIII, 6</cite> <he>השן שבטס</he> a key-ward fastened to a thin plate.
<cite ref="Shabbat 60a:6">Sabb. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>ט׳ של זהב וכ׳</he> the pin has on one end a gold plate.—Pl. <cite ref="I00591"><he>טַסִּים</he></cite>, <he>טַסִּין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:3">Kel. XI, 3</cite> <he>מן הט׳ וכ׳</he> of (tin) foil or other plating material; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 5:16">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. V, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 103a:3">Sabb. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>טַסֵּי משכן</he> the foils used for the Tabernacle (<cite ref="Exodus 39:3">Ex. XXXIX, 3</cite>).
